targets.expected_type: ∀ {n m k : ℕ} (net : Network n m), net.Nonnegative → ∀ (a : ClosedFormActivation) (wp wn : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ), (∀ i j, 0 ≤ wp i j) → (∀ i j, 0 ≤ wn i j) → ∀ bp bn : Vec k, Monotone (fun x : Vec n => net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : Vec n => (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).1 i)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : Vec n => (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).2 i)) ∧ ∀ x : Vec n, (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).1 - (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).2 = affineLayer wp wn bp bn (net.forwardWith a.eval x)
targets.scope: The affine input embedding produces ordinary-input convex monotone heads with exact recovery, without asserting their nonnegativity.
